purpose: Page-level dismissible region landmark that surfaces a persistent informational, success, warning, or danger message.
useWhen: Communicating a persistent page-level status the user can dismiss, such as a maintenance window or trial expiry.
Reporting that the browser is offline, the server is unreachable, a refresh failed or a restart is running, using a connection preset.
Pinning a non-urgent message above page content that should remain readable until acknowledged.
Announcing something new or inviting the person to try a feature, with the feature variant and its glyph art.

avoidWhen.reason: Announcing an urgent, time-sensitive message — use alert so assistive tech reads it immediately.
Highlighting an inline aside next to related prose — use callout instead.
